title: An other realistic MC
description: I tried to make the most realistic and fun Minecraft modpack
body:
If you want to convert a .mrpack to .zip you can go [here](https://tutorialy.net/mrpacktozip/)
It is a modpack that trys to make the game more realistic. It is possible that you have an error pack in the shaderpack folder, it is euphoria patch mod.

**Thanks Dorian for the gallery**

## ⚠️You must to give you a ship creator to make vehicles

# Features :
## Environement :
- ☁️Limit of height is to 511 blocks
- 🌍New world generation
- 🏜️New biomes
- 🏠New structures and vanilla structures rework
- 🐘New animals
- 👂🏻Ambiant sounds
- 🎥Camera overhaul
## Food :
- 🍔New food
## Automatisation :
- 🔧Create mod
## Physics :
- 🚗Can make vehicles (Boat, car, plane)
- 🔊Sond physics
- 🪽Elytra physic
- 🌳Falling tree
- 🔦Dynamic light
## Survival :
- 🐮Animals defends themself
- 💀Mobs are stronger
- 💧Hydration
- 🩹Body health
- 🌡️Temperatur
- ⚔️New weapons
- 👋🏻Better combat system
- 🎙️Voice chat
## Aesthetic
- 🌍Distant horizon
- 👋🏻Animations to third person
- 👀First person body
- 🪑Add Furnitures
- ⚔️Show your hotbar's tools and weapons on your body
- 🪜Sit on stairs and slabs
- ✨Particles
